goal: Communicate in-progress analysis of quiz responses with a maritime animated scene.

content.headline: جاري تحليل إجاباتك...
content.description: قريباً ستكتشف الشخصية التي تناسبك ضمن عالم GDGoC

composition.scene: Vertical view onto moonlit sea; rusty pirate galleon with red sails near upper-left; bright moon behind clouds upper-right; mountains at horizon.
composition.foreground: Oversized ripped parchment horizontally centered in the lower middle; lantern hanging on image-right and compass embedded lower-left; treasure chest, dock timbers, ropes and rocks along bottom.
composition.status_panel: Dark ink bold Arabic headline, a rounded long progress track with blue fill, supporting Arabic description beneath.
composition.depth: Background sea and ship behind, parchment and props in foreground.

components.heading: جاري تحليل إجاباتك...
components.body: قريباً ستكتشف الشخصية التي تناسبك ضمن عالم GDGoC

components.style: cream/gray track, bright blue filling bar, dark ink outline
components.accessibility: aria-busy on screen region; role=progressbar with aria-valuenow only when percent is real

mobile_layout.background: Cover portrait view, sea horizon in upper third; keep ship and moon visible without stretching.
mobile_layout.parchment: Width 85-92vw, place between ~44% and 77% of viewport; auto-grow with text.
mobile_layout.text: Center, heading 20-24px, description 14-16px, legible on cream.
mobile_layout.foreground_props: At edges and behind panel; no obstruction to text.
mobile_layout.height: 100dvh minimum with scroll safety on very short screens.

state_rules.on_entry: Start or continue result processing; loading screen should not be entered just to fake a waiting animation.
state_rules.on_complete: Route to result/{knownTrackId} once valid data arrives.
state_rules.progress: If backend exposes 0..100 validated progress, use it; otherwise animate an indeterminate bar, not a fabricated numeric percentage.
state_rules.on_error: Show short Arabic error and retry/back button within parchment.
state_rules.timeout: Do not silently hang; if request is stalled show actionable error.
state_rules.motion: Ship bob 2-3px and water sparkle very subtly; pause on reduced motion.
